claims: John Summit played a surprise DJ set at the Do LaB stage on Day 1 of Coachella Weekend 1 on April 10, 2026.
John Summit's set featured new music from his album.
John Summit's set featured "Lights Go Out".
John Summit's setlist highlights included "Go Back".
"Lights Go Out" is a new single.
A heavy lighting fixture fell into the crowd during John Summit's set.
The heavy lighting fixture fall caused at least one injury.
John Summit's set featured "office worker aesthetic" props.
Fans on Reddit called John Summit's set "a set that was bumpin".
Videos of John Summit's performance can be found on YouTube.
